name: Bruneau and Jarbidge Rivers
reach: Jarbidge Forks to 8 miles south of Bruneau (via Indian Hot Springs)
note: Preliminary entry: reach, access points and permit rules only. Mileage and map position are approximate; confirm against the managing agency.

items.d: Download a self-issue permit from the BLM website, or fill one out at the self-registration stations at the put-in and take-out. This covers both the Jarbidge (Jarbidge Forks to Indian Hot Springs) and the Bruneau (Indian Hot Springs to 8 miles south of Bruneau).
